record.category: inference endpoint, pay-as-you-go with an expiring welcome credit

free_tier.stated: a one-time USD 5 welcome credit after phone-number verification, expiring 30 days after claim; up to two bonuses (one personal, one organization); the underlying plan is pay-as-you-go prepaid credit

record.tooling: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.clarifai.com/v2/ext/openai/v1 plus the Clarifai SDK and CLI
record.chaining: pairs with an OpenAI-compatible agent only while the USD 5 credit lasts; the scarce link is the phone gate and the 30-day expiry

limits.value: the one-time USD 5 welcome bonus expires 30 days after it is claimed

record.binding_note: the 30-day credit expiry ends the free allowance before any rate limit is reached

identity_cost.detail: a phone number is verified by SMS to claim the free USD 5 credit; the same number may verify up to three accounts, but only one personal and one organization account get the bonus; a card is needed only to recharge after that

evidence.proved: the free USD 5 credit requires phone verification and is one-time
evidence.quote: After switching, click the notification bar and select Claim credits to verify your phone number and receive a one-time, free $5 credits, which can be used to try anything from serverless model access to dedicated deployments.

evidence.proved: the welcome bonus expires after 30 days
evidence.quote: The $5 welcome bonus has a 30-day expiration period.

evidence.proved: the Pay-As-You-Go plan allows up to 100 requests per second

record.notes: credits are expiring, not a standing tier.
